title: Overview of Dialog System Evaluation Track: Dimensionality, Language, Culture and Safety at DSTC 12

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating automatic safety classifiers on dialogue datasets translated into 7 different languages (Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese, and Chinese) to measure robustness and mitigate the predominant focus on the English language.

Assessing safety classifiers using a curated cultural subset of the SafeWorld dataset, which contains queries grounded in human-verified cultural norms and legal policies from 50 countries and 493 distinct regions/races.
